en.title: Passport photos for a baby

items.text: Eyes open, looking at the camera
A plain background behind the head
Under 6 months: lying on a plain sheet
6 months to 2 years: on a lap, adult not in frame
2 years and older: seated, looking just above the lens

en.focal: Most rejections: a supporting hand, a dummy or a toy in the background
en.alt: Diagram of what stays the same in a baby passport photo (eyes open, plain background, nothing else in frame) and what changes by age band from under 6 months to 2 years and older, with the most common rejection causes
